verdict.rationale: Carta documents programmatic cap-table retrieval: a capitalization table endpoint, stakeholder, option grant and convertible note endpoints, client-credentials OAuth for your own company's data, and an official Claude MCP cap-table plugin an agent can query. The reconciliation half of the story, checking the cap table against a data room before a financing, is not documented as a Carta capability. Missing for 10: any data-room integration or reconciliation workflow, endpoints that are still v1alpha1, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven cap-table pulls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent pull my current cap table programmatically and reconcile it against my data room before a financing

citations.quote: Retrieve an issuer's capitalization table by share class.
